hero.title: Every sip has
hero.description: Capture what you drank, where the night happened and who shared it with you. Drinka turns tastings into a personal archive worth revisiting.

experience.title: From a sip to a memory.
experience.description: A focused flow that keeps the details of a tasting without getting in the way of the moment.

capture.title: Capture the tasting
capture.description: Add a rating, notes, mood, food pairing, buy-again choice and bottle or memory photos.

place.title: Pin the place
place.description: Connect the tasting to a map location, saved place or venue and keep the date with it.

people.title: Remember the people
people.description: Add the friends who shared the table and see the memories you created together.

revisit.title: Return to the story
revisit.description: Browse your collection, search with Spotlight and rediscover nights through the map.

capabilities.title: More than a tasting log.
capabilities.description: Drinka connects your drinks, places, people and preferences into one thoughtful personal archive.

collection.title: Personal Collection
collection.description: Keep every saved tasting together and filter the drinks you have explored.

tryList.title: Try List
tryList.description: Save bottles and drinks for later, edit them anytime and track the list from a widget.

venues.title: Venues & Visits
venues.description: Save venues, revisit their history and begin a new tasting with the place already attached.

map.title: Map & Saved Places
map.description: See tastings, venues and personal places together or use the map as a location picker.

contacts.title: Shared Moments
contacts.description: Create a private people list and connect friends with tastings, venues and memories.

cocktails.title: Cocktail Catalog
cocktails.description: Explore cocktail recipes and ingredients in a dedicated catalog alongside your own records.

profile.title: Taste Profile & Insights
profile.description: Shape preferences around taste, mood and context, then see insights from your activity.

reminders.title: Smart Reminders
reminders.description: Get optional Try List, venue revisit, weekly summary and tasting anniversary reminders.

widgets.title: Home Screen Widgets
widgets.description: Start a quick add or keep your Try List count visible without opening the app.

search.title: Spotlight & Deep Links
search.description: Find tastings and venues from Spotlight and jump directly into the right screen.

sharing.title: Share In & Out
sharing.description: Create visual tasting cards or send an image from another app straight into a new record.

languages.title: 10 Languages
languages.description: Use Drinka in English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean or Chinese.

platform.title: Your archive, available when the night begins.

items.account: Anonymous, Apple, Google or email account
items.privacy: Private personal archive with account deletion controls
items.sync: Widget, Spotlight, notification and share integrations

cta.title: Make the night memorable.
cta.description: Download Drinka and give every bottle, place and shared moment a story of its own.

social.title: A good story deserves another round.
social.description: Know someone who would turn every tasting into a memory? Send Drinka their way.
social.shareText: Drinka turns every tasting into a memory worth keeping.
